persistent-boot.note: A USB-loaded RAM bootstrap is required for every Linux boot.

local-console.note: 128×160 graphical terminal with phone-keypad input; RTC wake preserves the shell in USB-powered RAM sessions. Terminal use with a microSD system root, operation without USB power and physical external keyboards are untested.

lcd-backlight.note: System scale 0…10 works; level 0 turns the backlight off.

keypad-backlight.note: Binary LED control; on and off are visible.

file-transfer.note: RAM destinations are supported. Card destinations require qualified fixed-session initialization; FAT32 transfers are unqualified.

manual-cpu-frequency-selection.note: Switching between 768 MHz and 1 GHz works on this phone.

ap-dmaengine.note: Memory copies and the fixed ROTA request; see platform limits.

image-rotation-engine.note: RGB, grayscale and two-plane YUV through V4L2 mem2mem.

jpeg-engine.note: Baseline decode, fixed encode geometries and fixed NV16 scaler pairs.

native-image-output.note: Native 128×160 NV16 or RGB565. Returns to the same terminal and shell; visible image fidelity is untested.

image-rotation.note: Explicit CPU/ROTA selection and DRM preview. Returns to the same terminal and shell; visible image fidelity is untested.

jpeg-codec-and-scaling.note: Hardware decode, fixed encode and fixed half-scaling.

native-image-presentation.note: Direct NV16 or CPU-converted RGB565 presentation. Returns to the same terminal and shell; visible image fidelity is untested.

removable-storage.note: The card stays installed from boot to shutdown; hot-swap is not supported. Fixed-session initialization has not been qualified on this phone.

removable-system-root.note: FAT32 FIT plus ext4 system root; fixed-session card initialization is unqualified.

internal-phone-storage.note: Read-only raw NAND backup; no filesystem, writes or restore.

headphone-audio.note: Stereo S16_LE playback; the default device converts input to 48 kHz, and the fitted profile supplies stock-derived levels, equalizer and ALC.

speaker-audio.note: Rear loudspeaker with fitted gains, stock equalizer and ALC.

phone-microphone.note: Built-in and four-contact wired-headset microphones record mono 48-kHz PCM.

fm-radio.note: RAM profile: scan and headphone/speaker playback with EQ/ALC off. EQ-on playback and microSD FM not tested.

bluetooth.note: Pairing, bidirectional OPP, PAN Internet and recovery after RTC-woken s2idle work in both profiles; keyboards and mice have not been tested.

camera.note: BF30A2; 240×320 NV16 through V4L2 in the RAM profile. Camera with a microSD system root is unqualified. Sensor rotation is 0°; the native geometry is accepted by hardware JPEG. Capture and codec jobs may run concurrently at native size, including through display updates, blanking and wake.

charger-status.note: External-input status is available; battery charging has not been tested.

battery-telemetry.note: Voltage, current and charge counter respond; measurements with a battery have not been tested.

soc-temperature.note: Temperature readings are available; physical accuracy has not been checked.

auxiliary-adc.note: Raw-channel interface enabled; physical inputs and accuracy have not been checked.

real-time-clock.note: Read/set time, one-shot alarms and RTC wake work in both profiles; no update interrupts or alarm power-on.

other-battery-functions.note: No battery level, temperature or charge control is provided.

vibration.note: Rear speaker vibration; headphone audio is muted meanwhile, and one continuous pulse lasts at most about three seconds.

power-off.note: Establish card safety before disconnecting USB power; battery-only power-off has not been tested.

suspend.note: s2idle with RTC/red-handset wake and Bluetooth; mounted-card and card-backed-swap sleep is unqualified with fixed-session card initialization.

fplinux-armada.note: Runs in both profiles; physical display and light effects have not been tested.

brightness-control.note: Phone-keypad control of levels 0…10; level 0 turns the backlight off.

tyrquake.note: Game data can use RAM or ext4 microSD storage, including the system root; fixed-session card initialization is unqualified.

headset-microphone.note: Four-contact wired-headset recording; select the Headset source manually.

automatic-audio-routing.note: Insert/remove selects the playback output in USB-powered RAM sessions; switching a playing signal can click.

bluetooth-pairing.note: Pairing in RAM and microSD profiles.

bluetooth-file-transfer.note: Bidirectional OPP in RAM and microSD profiles.

bluetooth-pan-internet.note: PAN Internet in RAM and microSD profiles.

bluetooth-a2dp-linux-pc.note: A2DP audio has not been tested on this phone.

bluetooth-a2dp-headsets.note: Physical Bluetooth headsets have not been tested.

bluetooth-keyboard.note: Physical Bluetooth keyboard input has not been tested.

bluetooth-mouse.note: Physical Bluetooth mouse input has not been tested.

mobile-calls.note: Calls have no supported FPLinux path.

sms.note: SMS has no supported FPLinux path.

mobile-data.note: Mobile data has no supported FPLinux path.

ffmpeg.note: Optional CPU MPEG-4 Part 2, H.263 and H.264 decoding; device use is untested.
